description: Retrieves advisory EDGA model templates, constitutional clauses, and administrative checklists for establishing a volunteer-led disc golf club in England. The tool prompts for or accepts customisation variables (such as club_name, adoption_date, and welfare_officer) to generate ready-to-adopt Word (.docx) documents.

include_disclaimers.description: Whether to include mandatory legal, insurance, and safeguarding disclaimers.

topic.description: The specific governance or operational document required.

variables.description: Optional key-value pairs to populate template placeholders (e.g. club_name, adoption_date, welfare_officer, event_name). If omitted, the tool returns the required placeholders for the AI assistant to prompt the user before generating their personalised Word document.

name: get_club_starter_guidance
